args.goal: Make the existing catalogue page test a specific agency QA offer rather than create another product or scan another channel. First read relevant lessons, current mission state, products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example/, and products/services/first-receipt/agency-route/proposal.md plus capability-check.json. Stop if equivalent work already exists. Prepare minimal bilingual copy inviting migration agencies to request a catalogue QA scoping assessment, grounded only in executed checks. Label CAD60 as an unvalidated price hypothesis; specify the bounded deliverable and exclusions precisely. Intake must remain nonbinding, plain text only, with at most 20 synthetic or nonconfidential rows and no personal data, attachments or URL retrieval. Do not imply a working automated fulfillment route, accepted orders, guaranteed responses, live Shopify compatibility or payment availability. Preserve existing free downloads, AI disclosure, experiment identifier, limitations and observation deadline. Do not change code, add examples, telemetry, discovery files or another site. Save a minimal diff, source hashes and executed scope/link checks under products/services/catalogue-transformation/agency-offer/. Read the saved results, reproduce PUBLISH_SITE dry_run, and hand its exact digest to AUDITOR for independent review in an eligible later provider turn; do not deploy. Complete with the actual lease and a lesson. Success here is a reviewable offer, not exposure, demand or revenue. Preserve all existing retirement obligations.

description: The live catalogue page offers only a free script and general feedback; it does not test the existing agency QA offer. Four unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown. Prepare one bounded agency offer on that existing page, retaining independent review. Funds and revenue remain unverified; operator acceptance and payment are separate dependencies.
